messages:
emma.marketing: Hey team — can we build a compact, modular set of benchmark assets for the launch + webinar? Need one atomic Figma library that outputs hero banners, social tiles, email headers, and an inbound-routing micro-diagram. Primary goal: speed for SDRs and webinar landing page updates.

javier.design: Do you want one master file with component variants or separate files per channel?

emma.marketing: Master file with variants. Designers should be able to toggle metrics (latency / cost / throughput) and swap copy tiers. Also need an automated PNG/JPG export preset for ops.

sam.content: I'll draft two headline directions (outcome-forward vs product-forward). Which should be hero-first?

emma.marketing: Hero = outcome-forward (e.g., "Ship LLM features with predictable latency and cost"). Social tiles can lean product-forward.

javier.design: Cool. Data format question: will you drop canonical benchmark numbers as CSV, or JSON? I need precise values for the metric modules.

emma.marketing: CSV preferred. I’ll attach a sample CSV by EOD. Include template tokens for CMS auto-fill: {{model}}, {{p50_latency_ms}}, {{tokens_per_sec}}.

javier.design: Noted. Two design constraints: 1) hero must be safe across 16:9 and 4:3 crops, 2) tiles must remain legible at 120px width.

maddie.ops: Export presets ops needs: hero (1200x628 PNG @1x and @2x), social tile (1080x1080 PNG and 600x600 JPG fallback), email header (600x200 PNG), diagram (1200x600 SVG + PNG). Filename pattern: launch_bench_{variant}_{locale}.png; ensure S3-safe characters.

priya.brand: Brand rules: don't use secondary blue (#0A9EFF) as full-bleed hero background. Use brand-primary gradient + subtle ink overlay. Fonts: Inter variable weights 400 and 600 only. Ensure AA contrast for body and AAA for headings where possible. Include explicit token for locale-aware copy length.

legalbot: Reminder: no customer-identifying metrics or PII in public assets. Use anonymized sample numbers or placeholders. Final assets must go through legal review before publish.

oliver.product: Add a micro inbound flow diagram option: Landing page → Webinar signup → HubSpot tagging → SDR routing. Diagram should use our playbook icon set (rounded glyphs) and be exportable as SVG.

javier.design: Draft component spec I added to Figma: 

component: benchmark-atom
variants: [hero, social-1080, social-600, email-header, micro-diagram]
sizes:
  hero: 1200x628
  social-1080: 1080x1080
  social-600: 600x600
  email-header: 600x200
  micro-diagram: flexible (SVG)
fonts: Inter var (400,600)
colors: brand-primary-gradient, ink-90 overlay
exports: PNG @1x, PNG @2x (hero), JPG fallback for social if >200KB
filename: launch_bench_{variant}_{locale}.png

javier.design: ETA — first-pass Figma upload by tomorrow 11:30am PST. I’ll leave comments on metric token placement and cropping.

emma.marketing: Perfect. I’ll attach the CSV and the webinar deck snippets after standup.

sam.content: Copy drafts are in the doc (link in Figma comments). Two headline sets posted.

javier.design: First pass uploaded: https://figma.com/file/zzz123/modular-bench-atomics — added slices and export notes. Please annotate any locale edge cases.

priya.brand: Quick brand review: increase horizontal padding on hero when metric strip is enabled to prevent overlap at 4:3 crop. Also add a high-contrast text variant for dark-mode email clients. :white_check_mark:

maddie.ops: Ops checklist: exported social PNGs must be <=200KB; if not, produce a 600x600 JPG fallback. Include locale code in filename. Also tag exports with metadata file (CSV) that lists {filename, variant, locale, copy_version}.

emma.marketing: Thanks. Next steps: I’ll upload CSV now, legal will queue review, Javier iterates, ops verifies exports. Target: lock assets by EOD Friday for webinar go-live.

legalbot: Once files are in shared drive mark them for review. I will flag any asset that references internal customer data.

javier.design: Will add 2 accessibility color variants and push fixes for padding. I’ll post final export links in this thread when done.

emma.marketing: Great teamwork — drop final links here when you have them. :rocket:
